goal: Confirm that corporate board resolutions require a quorum of at least three directors including the independent chair.
successCriteria: Verify board quorum clause in corporate bylaws.

evidence.passage: Section 3.2 Quorum: No board resolution shall be validly adopted without a quorum of at least three directors present, which must include the independent chair.

proposedAnswer: Corporate board resolutions require a quorum of at least three directors including the independent chair.
